name: FF All-New Futurist
summary: FF All-New Futurist is Faraday Future's newer full-size professional humanoid, sold in two editions: All-New Futurist ($89,900) and All-New Futurist Ultra ($129,900), per FF's own page.

Separate from the catalogued ff-futurist (older page https://robotics.ff.com/us/ff-futurist/, banner 'FF New Futurist - Coming Soon on 6/22'); relationship not stated beyond that, not merged. Page title 'FF All-New Futurist: Full-Size Humanoid Robot'; 'Order Now', 'Start From $89,900'. Specs table: height ≈174 cm both; weight ≈54 kg / ≈58 kg; DOF 31 / 51 ('Can be updated to 71 DOF with advanced Dex Hands'); joint peak torque 320 N·m; battery 1152 Wh dual; endurance over 6 h / over 5 h; compute dual RK3588 / Jetson Thor-U + dual RK3588 · 700 TOPS; LiDAR N/A / Equipped.
